LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Bar. m.]
Tension in thighs.
Emaciation of thighs.
When kneeling, a violent stitch, followed by a peculiar tension in right patella, making it difficult to walk. θ Hemorrhagic extravasation of knee.
Tension and increased warmth in knee. θ Swelling of knee.
Fine stinging in and around swollen knee.
A globular swelling on tip of right knee, increasing quickly but without much pain. θ Hemorrhagic swelling of knee.
A round, sharply defined swelling, size of a goose egg, of a dark color and clearly fluctuating, surrounded by bluish-red spots, not disappearing on pressure, with a greenish-yellow halo. θ Hemorrhagic extravasation.
Hemorrhagic extravasation in bursa patellæ.
After checking foot sweat. θ Tonsillitis.
Feet swollen. θ Glandular swelling.
Cramps in toes.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Bar. m.]
Trembling of limbs.
Convulsive jerkings of hands and feet.
Paralysis of upper and lower limbs.
Swelling of hands and feet.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Bar. m.]
Lying on painful side : earache worse.
Has to sit up, head bent forward : breathing >. θ Induration of pancreas.
When kneeling : violent stitch in right patella.
Neither motion nor pressure is painful. θ Gonitis.
   

NERVES. [36] [Bar. m.]
Convulsive tremor and twitches.
Convulsions, accompanied by shocks which shake whole body.
Periodical attacks of convulsions, with excessive jactitation of limbs.
Heaviness and prostration, must lie down.
Prostration, can scarcely move a limb.
Paralysis.
Paralysis of left side, with aphasia.
General muscular weakness.
General malaise. θ Angina.
Faintings.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Bar. m.]
Sneezing in sleep not wakening.
After sleep toothache worse.
   

TIME. [38] [Bar. m.]
Morning : pain in region of navel worse.
Day : attacks of dyspnœa ; dry heat.
Evening : chill, with thirst.
Night : pollutions ; dyspnœa ; painless jerking in arms.
Before midnight : sneezing in sleep.
After midnight : toothache.
   

TEMPERATURE AND WEATHER. [39] [Bar. m.]
Sipping cold water : earache better.
Spring and Fall attacks of angina tonsillaris.
   

FEVER. [40] [Bar. m.]
Fever : thirst ; loss of appetite ; dry mouth and tongue ; dysphagia ; frequent, full pulse ; flushed face ; prostration generally lasting seven days, occasionally accompanied by catarrh of eye, ear or nose, or inflammatory action of skin.
Chill with thirst in evening ; loss of appetite and vomiting.
Dry heat all day ; pulse excitable ; head affected.
During fever increased suppuration of ulcers with boys, and enlargement of swollen cervical glands with girls.
Heat, with coryza.
(In sick :) All day dry heat ; pulse irritated ; head affected.
Discoloring sweat.
Cold sweat.
Tertian intermittent.
Chills with heat, alternately with angina tonsillaris.
   

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Bar. m.]
Right : earache ; parotids ; pain side of throat and ear ; fauces of side deep red color ; deglutition painful on side ; stitch in patella ; globular swelling tip of knee.
Left : staphyloma on inner edge of cornea ; below stomach to side a hardness from which paroxysms of want of breath originate ; paralysis of side.
Below upward : burning.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Bar. m.]
Stitches : in nodule on nose ; in teeth ; in testicles ; in right patella.
Stinging : in and around knee.
Jerking : in teeth ; in arms.
Drawing : in facial muscles.
Biting : in nodule on nose ; in skin.
Burning : in stomach.
Pressure : in stomach.
Soreness : in nodule on nose.
Squeezing pains : in pelvis.
Cramps : in stomach ; in toes.
Undefined pain : in ears ; in right side of throat and ear ; in region of navel.
Throbbing : toothache ; in tumor in abdomen.
Tension : in face ; in thigh ; in right patella ; in knee.
Tickling : in nodule on nose.
Warmth : rises to chest and head.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Bar. m.]
Increased irritability of nerves.
Varicose veins. θ Angina tonsillaris.
Affection of lymphatic vessels and glands in scrofula.
Hydrops after scarlatina.
Painful glandular swellings and indurations of scrofulous people.
Adenitis.
Catarrhal affections.
Pale and emaciated. θ Dysentery.
Emaciation. θ Swelling of cervical glands.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Bar. m.]
Pressure : submaxillary and cervical glands < ; no effect on swollen knee.
Swelling of testicle and scrotum from bruising, caused by riding horseback.
Touch : stitches in nodule side of nose.
   

SKIN. [46] [Bar. m.]
Biting sensation in skin.
Spasmodic contraction of skin.
Skin not reddened, not warmer than usual. θ Swelling of parotis.
Inflammation of skin.
Itch-like pimples on head, nape of neck, abdomen and thighs.
Yellowish, scaly eruptions.
Herpes on various parts. θ Hypertrophy of testicle.
Herpes favinosus all over body, face excepted.
Tetters.
Scrofulous eruptions.
Fetid ichorous ulcers in inguinal region.
Whole body covered with ulcers. θ Scrofula.
Complaints after scarlet fever.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Bar. m.]
Scrofulous children. See 13, 27, 31.
Child, æt. 18 months. θ Dysentery after humid tetter.
Girl, æt. 18 months. θ Scrofulous ulcers.
Boy, æt. 2, scrofulous, emaciated. θ Indurated cervical glands.
Boy, æt. 4, three weeks after scarlatina. θ Swelling of parotis.
Blonde, blue-eyed girl. θ Earache.
Scrofulous child, æt. 10, since five years otorrhœa and glandular swellings, cured by one dose daily for two weeks.
Girls, æt. 39. θ Hemorrhagic extravasation of knee.
Man, æt. 50, strong constitution, inclined to catarrhal affections, and great disposition to angina tonsillaris.
Woman, æt. 53, small, weakly, poorly fed. θ Parotid swelling.
Woman, æt. 65, after five months absolute rest and strict diet having been useless, 1/5 grain in distilled water, three times daily, for several weeks. θ Abdominal aneurism.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Bar. m.]
Absinthe antidotes the vomiting.
Useful after Arnic. in extravasations of blood.
Similar to Conium in indurations of abdominal glands.
